toefl:se:377.answer: Please let me know which days or times work best for you.
toefl:se:377.fullSentence: Please let me know which days or times work best for you.
keyPhrases: which days or times work best for you
toefl:se:377.japanese: どの日やどの時間が一番都合良いか教えてください。
toefl:se:377.relatedInfo: let me know your availability / tell me a good time

toefl:se:378.answer: I'll make sure we have a fun celebration just for you!
toefl:se:378.fullSentence: I'll make sure we have a fun celebration just for you!
keyPhrases: make sure we have a fun celebration just for you
toefl:se:378.japanese: あなたのためだけの楽しいお祝いになるようにします！
toefl:se:378.explanation: just for youで「あなただけのために」を強調する。
toefl:se:378.relatedInfo: plan something special just for you / make it a celebration to remember

toefl:se:379.answer: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
toefl:se:379.fullSentence: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
keyPhrases: looking forward to hearing from you
toefl:se:379.japanese: ご連絡をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:379.explanation: メールの結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:379.relatedInfo: look forward to your reply / awaiting your response

toefl:se:380.explanation: Dear 〜,はビジネスメールの宛先を示す定型の書き出し。
toefl:se:380.relatedInfo: Dear Sir or Madam, / To whom it may concern,

toefl:se:381.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:381.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this email finds you well
toefl:se:381.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:381.explanation: ビジネスメール冒頭の定型挨拶表現。
toefl:se:381.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well. / I hope this message finds you well.

toefl:se:382.answer: I am writing about an issue with my work laptop.
toefl:se:382.fullSentence: I am writing about an issue with my work laptop.
toefl:se:382.japanese: 仕事用のノートパソコンの不具合について書いています。
toefl:se:382.explanation: I am writing about〜はメールの用件を伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:382.relatedInfo: I am contacting you regarding / I am reaching out about

toefl:se:383.answer: Since the recent software update, my laptop has been running much slower than before.
toefl:se:383.fullSentence: Since the recent software update, my laptop has been running much slower than before.
toefl:se:383.japanese: 最近のソフトウェアアップデート以降、私のノートパソコンは以前よりもずっと動作が遅くなっています。
toefl:se:383.explanation: 現在完了進行形(has been running)で「更新以降ずっと遅い状態が続いている」ことを表す。
toefl:se:383.relatedInfo: has become noticeably slower / has been performing poorly

toefl:se:384.answer: Because of this, it takes longer to open programs and complete tasks, which is affecting my daily work and making it harder to meet deadlines.
toefl:se:384.fullSentence: Because of this, it takes longer to open programs and complete tasks, which is affecting my daily work and making it harder to meet deadlines.
toefl:se:384.japanese: そのため、プログラムを開いたりタスクを完了させたりするのに時間がかかるようになり、日々の業務に影響が出て、締め切りを守るのが難しくなっています。
toefl:se:384.explanation: which以下は関係代名詞の非制限用法で、前文全体を受けて結果を補足している。
toefl:se:384.relatedInfo: is impacting my workflow / is making it difficult to hit deadlines

toefl:se:385.answer: Could you please help resolve this problem or let me know what steps I can take to fix it?
toefl:se:385.fullSentence: Could you please help resolve this problem or let me know what steps I can take to fix it?
keyPhrases: could you please help resolve this problem
what steps i can take to fix it
toefl:se:385.japanese: この問題の解決をお手伝いいただくか、解決のために私が取れる手順を教えていただけますでしょうか。
toefl:se:385.explanation: Could you please〜?は丁寧な依頼を表す定型表現。orで二つの依頼を並べている。
toefl:se:385.relatedInfo: Would you be able to assist with / Could you advise me on how to

toefl:se:386.japanese: ご支援いただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:386.explanation: would appreciate〜は丁寧に感謝・依頼を伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:386.relatedInfo: Your support would be appreciated. / I would be grateful for your help.

toefl:se:387.answer: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
toefl:se:387.fullSentence: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
keyPhrases: looking forward to hearing from you
toefl:se:387.japanese: ご連絡をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:387.explanation: メールの結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:387.relatedInfo: I look forward to your reply / awaiting your response

toefl:se:388.explanation: ビジネスメールの結びの定型句。

toefl:se:389.relatedInfo: Dear Sir or Madam, / To whom it may concern,

toefl:se:390.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:390.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this message finds you well
toefl:se:390.japanese: このメッセージが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:390.explanation: I hope this message finds you well.はI hope this email finds you well.と同義の挨拶表現。
toefl:se:390.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well. / I hope this email finds you well.

toefl:se:391.answer: I'm writing to inform you about some ongoing issues I have experienced with my work laptop following the recent software update.
toefl:se:391.fullSentence: I'm writing to inform you about some ongoing issues I have experienced with my work laptop following the recent software update.
keyPhrases: writing to inform you about some ongoing issues
toefl:se:391.japanese: 最近のソフトウェアアップデート以降、仕事用のノートパソコンで発生している継続的な問題についてお知らせするために書いています。
toefl:se:391.explanation: I'm writing to inform you about〜はメールの用件を丁寧に伝える表現。followingは「〜の後に」という前置詞。
toefl:se:391.relatedInfo: I am writing to let you know about / after the recent update

toefl:se:392.answer: Since the installation, the laptop has been noticeably slower, which has made it difficult to complete my daily tasks efficiently.
toefl:se:392.fullSentence: Since the installation, the laptop has been noticeably slower, which has made it difficult to complete my daily tasks efficiently.
keyPhrases: difficult to complete my daily tasks efficiently
toefl:se:392.japanese: インストール以降、ノートパソコンは明らかに遅くなっており、そのせいで日々のタスクを効率的にこなすのが難しくなっています。
toefl:se:392.explanation: which以下は関係代名詞の非制限用法で前文の内容を受けて結果を補足している。
toefl:se:392.relatedInfo: has clearly slowed down / has become hard to use efficiently

toefl:se:393.answer: The slow processing speed is especially problematic when using resource-intensive applications, such as data analysis tools and project management software that are essential for my role.
toefl:se:393.fullSentence: The slow processing speed is especially problematic when using resource-intensive applications, such as data analysis tools and project management software that are essential for my role.
toefl:se:393.japanese: 処理速度の低下は、私の業務に不可欠なデータ分析ツールやプロジェクト管理ソフトウェアなど、負荷の高いアプリケーションを使う際に特に問題となります。
toefl:se:393.explanation: such as〜は「〜のような」と具体例を挙げる表現。

toefl:se:394.answer: Tasks that normally take only a few minutes now take much longer.
toefl:se:394.fullSentence: Tasks that normally take only a few minutes now take much longer.
keyPhrases: normally take only a few minutes
toefl:se:394.japanese: 通常であれば数分しかかからない作業に、今ではずっと長い時間がかかっています。
toefl:se:394.explanation: that以下はTasksを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:394.relatedInfo: used to take just a few minutes / now takes significantly longer

toefl:se:395.answer: This slowdown has significantly affected my productivity.
toefl:se:395.fullSentence: This slowdown has significantly affected my productivity.
toefl:se:395.japanese: この動作の遅さは私の生産性に大きな影響を与えています。
toefl:se:395.explanation: has affectedは現在完了で、過去から続く影響を表す。
toefl:se:395.relatedInfo: has greatly impacted my output / has hurt my efficiency

toefl:se:396.answer: Additionally, simple actions like opening files or switching between applications have become frustratingly sluggish, causing unnecessary delays in my workflow.
toefl:se:396.fullSentence: Additionally, simple actions like opening files or switching between applications have become frustratingly sluggish, causing unnecessary delays in my workflow.
toefl:se:396.japanese: さらに、ファイルを開いたりアプリケーション間を切り替えたりといった簡単な操作までも、いらだたしいほど動作が重くなり、業務の流れに不要な遅延を引き起こしています。
toefl:se:396.explanation: causing以下は分詞構文で、前文の結果を補足している。
toefl:se:396.relatedInfo: have become annoyingly slow / creating needless delays

toefl:se:397.answer: I would greatly appreciate it if you could provide technical support to assess and resolve the issue as soon as possible.
toefl:se:397.fullSentence: I would greatly appreciate it if you could provide technical support to assess and resolve the issue as soon as possible.
toefl:se:397.japanese: できるだけ早く問題を確認し解決していただくための技術サポートをご提供いただけますと大変ありがたく存じます。
toefl:se:397.explanation: would appreciate it if you could〜は非常に丁寧な依頼表現。
toefl:se:397.relatedInfo: It would be great if you could / I'd be grateful if you could

toefl:se:398.answer: It would be helpful if we could arrange a time for you to look into the laptop or suggest any temporary solutions that could alleviate these performance problems in the meantime.
toefl:se:398.fullSentence: It would be helpful if we could arrange a time for you to look into the laptop or suggest any temporary solutions that could alleviate these performance problems in the meantime.
keyPhrases: arrange a time for you to look into the laptop
toefl:se:398.japanese: ノートパソコンを確認していただく時間を調整するか、その間にこれらの性能上の問題を軽減できる暫定的な対策をご提案いただけると助かります。
toefl:se:398.explanation: that以下はsolutionsを修飾する関係代名詞節。in the meantimeは「その間に」という意味の副詞句。
toefl:se:398.relatedInfo: set up a time to check / a temporary fix in the meantime

toefl:se:399.answer: Thank you very much for your prompt attention to this matter.
toefl:se:399.fullSentence: Thank you very much for your prompt attention to this matter.
keyPhrases: thank you very much for your prompt attention
toefl:se:399.japanese: この件への迅速なご対応、誠にありがとうございます。
toefl:se:399.explanation: Thank you for your prompt attention to〜はビジネスメールで感謝を伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:399.relatedInfo: Thank you for addressing this quickly / I appreciate your quick response

toefl:se:400.answer: I look forward to your assistance in resolving this issue.
toefl:se:400.fullSentence: I look forward to your assistance in resolving this issue.
toefl:se:400.japanese: この問題の解決にあたってのご協力をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:400.explanation: look forward to〜はメールの結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:400.relatedInfo: I look forward to your help with this / awaiting your support on this issue

toefl:se:401.explanation: ビジネスメールの結びの定型句。
